mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.description, p.character_prompt, p.style_prompt, p.enabled, p.is_default, p.version, p.created_at, p.updated_at, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bot_settings bs CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(bs.group_reply_policies) policy WHERE (policy ->> 'personaId') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (policy ->> 'personaId')::bigint = p.id ) AS bound_group_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bot_personas p ORDER BY p.is_default DESC, p.enabled DESC, p.id
SELECT FROM bot_personas p WHERE p.is_default = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bot_personas SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, character_prompt = #{characterPrompt}, style_prompt = #{stylePrompt}, enabled = #{enabled}, version = #{version}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bot_personas SET is_default = FALSE, updated_at = now() WHERE is_default = TRUE
UPDATE bot_personas SET is_default = TRUE, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bot_settings bs CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(bs.group_reply_policies) policy WHERE (policy ->> 'personaId') ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND (policy ->> 'personaId')::bigint = #{id}
